decisions.reason: The accelerator program remained prominently featured through 2024 and, as a relatively low-cost adjacent option that can generate partnerships, deal flow and learning for the core recycling business, it is worth keeping open.

The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder still had its own dedicated page in 2024, and for a growing R&D-active firm this suggests uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to abandon an adjacent sustainability option with potential upside.

The infectious waste decontamination plant stayed on the home page in 2024 and is close to the firm's core modular waste-treatment capabilities, so its strategic fit and still-active promotion justify continued commitment.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant disappeared from the website by 2024, which is a strong sign that market feedback has reduced its expected value enough that resources should be reallocated to stronger core and development options.
